title: 검찰 및 특별사법경찰관리 등의 개인정보 처리에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 검찰 및 특별사법경찰관리 등의 개인정보 처리에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 3 (Processing of Sensitive Information, etc. by Special Judicial Police Officers) Where unavoidable for the investigation of crimes and the performance of duties necessary therefor under Article 245-10 of the Criminal Procedure Act, a person performing duties of a judicial police officer under the Act on Persons Performing Duties of Judicial Police Officers and the Scope of Their Duties may process materials containing sensitive information under Article 23 of the Act, personally identifiable information under Article 24 of the Act, resident registration numbers under Article 24-2 of the Act, and other personal information. <Amended on Jul. 5, 2022>
